correctness.rationale: Exact binomial definition, published identity 2M=3T+2Tnext-Tnext2 and Lucas factorization modulo five reduce every adjacent pair to 20 explicit carry cases. The product-count lemma on the four-element unit group and the trailing-four decomposition prove uniform O(r+1) joint-block counts, the 80-case table and all-N O(log^2 N) bound. Nonzero U and no (0,0) finite case prove the global nonoccurrence. Exact finite checker confirms arithmetic inputs, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Against inspected primary arithmetic papers, related recurrence studies, accessible mathematical records, sequence tables and historical claim identifiers, no theorem with the same object, complete two-point distribution and polylogarithmic discrepancy was found. Pre-existing Lucas congruence, zero-index conditions and marginal density are credited. Search nonappearance does not prove uniqueness; implicit automatic-sequence specializations remain the main priority risk.
residual_risks: An earlier automated calculation from the published modulo-five Motzkin automaton might yield the same table, even without an indexed theorem.
Other specialized word-frequency papers and later Kohen appendices have not all been exhaustively inspected.
Current tests are finite and do not independently validate the infinite induction.

value.rationale: The previously studied Motzkin modulo-five automatic word has known individual zero density but no joint characterization in checked work. The theorem gives the full 25-cell correlation law with a sharply distinguished zero-zero obstruction and quantitative uniform control for every cutoff. These exact joint statistics answer a motivated missing two-point question and expose nonindependence, not just a routine single residue re-enumeration.
